title: A rare guest in the hernia sac: Preoperatively diagnosed Amyand's hernia with gangrenous appendicitis

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A rare guest in the hernia sac: Preoperatively diagnosed Amyand's hernia with gangrenous appendicitis》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Amyand's hernia is a rare clinical entity defined by the presence of the vermiform appendix within an inguinal hernia sac, with acute appendicitis occurring in this setting being exceptionally uncommon.

evidence.text: Amyand's hernia is a rare clinical entity defined by the presence of the vermiform appendix within an inguinal hernia sac, with acute appendicitis occurring in this setting being exceptionally uncommon.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】The patient underwent urgent laparoscopic exploration, which confirmed an acutely inflamed, gangrenous appendix partially contained within the hernia sac.

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】The patient recovered without immediate complications.
